check.feedback_fil: Naihihiwalay nito ang obserbasyon, nagawa, at kailangan. Bigkasin ang sarili mong handover at ipaliwanag kung paano mo nasunod ang tagubilin; ang pagpili ng sagot ay hindi praktikal na assessment.
check.feedback_en: It separates observation, action taken, and remaining needs. Speak your own handover and explain how you followed the instruction; selecting an answer is not a practical assessment.
